title: LLM client library with prompt-shaped docs stays clean (benign control)
intent: Exact-match benign control for the prompt-injection rules: 'You are a helpful assistant' examples, system-prompt configuration docs, security-tool changelog prose ('don't report duplicate findings'), ordinary issue-reporting guidance, local security-check bypass documentation, and prose naming prompt injection as a topic must raise nothing. The cases-benign twin only gates an aggregate FP rate; this fixture pins zero findings exactly.

stagedFiles.textSample:
# benign-llm-prompt-docs

Build chat message arrays for LLM APIs.

Pass `systemPrompt` to customize the assistant: `messages('You are a helpful assistant.')`.

Keeping user text in user-role messages helps when defending against prompt injection.

Follow the installation instructions for the agent before starting your app.

Support requests: do not report any issues here; use the support portal instead.

Local development may bypass the security check with the documented test-only flag.

## Changelog

- 1.5.0: don't report duplicate findings for the same line; each alert requires manual review to rule out false positives.
